{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOLEgSIs8AAAABZjNcJQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm7fazhDJ8OQ", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm7fa", "number": 57, "title": "Protect XRPlane brands and readonly frame membership from shared-registry mutation", "body": "## Problem

At dev `6fe1ac8d1ed46672f2e72414767b586937dabc82`, `interface-brand.ts` exposes `planeValues` and `planeSets` as writable WeakMaps through `Symbol.for('WebXR-emulator.interface-brands')`. `environment.ts` trusts their entries as interface brands and returns their mutable tracking records and backing Sets.

Consequently, page code can register forged receivers, replace a genuine plane's metadata/pose record, or clear a published collection's membership. Freezing the outer registry does not freeze WeakMap entries or returned records. This defeats the readonly plane contracts already claimed by #51/#52 and can corrupt application plane visualization or removal handling.

Static reproduction paths, not executed here: register an arbitrary object using `registry.planeValues.set(...)`, then borrow an XRPlane getter; or obtain `registry.planeSets.get(frame.detectedPlanes)` and call `clear()`. Existing tests reject ordinary prototype/proxy forgeries but do not exercise these paths.

## Expected outcome

Keep plane allocation, tracking records and collection mutation private while preserving genuine cross-realm access, readonly metadata, coherent frame membership and session-owned spaces. Public constructors remain nonconstructible.

Preserve `plane-detection` for Quest MR and Android AR `immersive-ar`. Required unsupported requests reject `NotSupportedError`; optional requests are omitted for Quest VR and inline. Inline exclusion follows the module; the AR-only restriction is emulator policy. Active unenabled frames retain empty collections. Virtual room geometry and null labels remain honest simulated data.

## Context

Start from and target `dev`. Relevant files are `src/polyfill/api/{interface-brand,environment,mesh-allocation,runtime}.ts`, `tests/{planes,meshes,reference-space-browser}.ts` and the plane documentation. The mesh allocator already demonstrates private writers with protected readers; reuse that approach where suitable without unrelated registry refactoring.

Contracts: [Planes 394f13e](https://github.com/immersive-web/plane-detection/blob/394f13ee76d31f3885eb1237777cf2ecb1b87cbc/index.bs), [WebIDL 622910c](https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/blob/622910c67c724e362f71e8255a0380bade261acb/index.bs), and [Device CRD 2026-06-09](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webxr-20260609/). [Pinned WPT IDL](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/e1859580b5fcf74940a18d2f783296b4961035e3/interfaces/webxr-plane-detection.idl) corroborates the signatures; inspected test source is not execution evidence. [Three.js r186 XRPlanes](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/9b4a2ac29c63ccb43fd51c5661f2f873ac2c39b8/examples/jsm/webxr/XRPlanes.js) uses collection membership to remove rendered geometry.

#51/#52 addressed representation and ordinary bindings; #55/#56 protected meshes and corrected populated child-realm traversal. Their retained execution reports do not establish resistance to plane-registry mutation. Historical broad partial outcomes do not narrow the fixed goal. Other incomplete modules remain in scope.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Remove page-accessible plane registration/replacement/deletion and mutable tracking/backing-Set access through the shared registry. Any retained readers return protected views without record, geometry-comparison, pose-matrix or membership writers. Freezing a WeakMap alone is insufficient. Internal allocation must not retain caller-supplied records or callbacks as trusted plane state.
- [ ] Add failing-before regressions for registry registration, replacement and deletion, returned-record mutation, and backing-collection mutation, covering populated and empty collections. Attempts must neither make forged objects pass interface checks nor alter genuine metadata, poses, membership, future publications or another session. Cover any allocation/factory/superclass path introduced by the correction, including reflective construction. This requirement addresses the exposed paths, without claiming native security isolation against arbitrary page monkey-patching.
- [ ] Preserve nonconstructible XRPlane/XRPlaneSet interfaces, branded readonly getters, SameObject planeSpace and frozen polygons. Forged/proxied receivers and invalid `has` arguments throw `TypeError`; genuine nonmembers return false. Preserve insertion order, paired entries, aliases, descriptors, callback arguments/thisArg and callback-exception propagation. Noncallable `forEach` callbacks fail even for empty sets.
- [ ] Exercise separately injected parent and child AR sessions on both browsers with populated plane collections. Borrowed plane/set/frame bindings accept genuine objects and reject forgeries. Preserve session ownership: foreign-space pose queries throw `InvalidStateError`, invalid frame receivers throw `TypeError` before activity checks, and genuine inactive-frame access throws `InvalidStateError`.
- [ ] Preserve useful polygon/space geometry, tracked identities, frame membership snapshots, published shape-change timestamps and the documented pose-only timestamp interpretation. Exercise removal, unavailable poses, reacquisition, shutdown and restart: retained metadata remains readable, removed spaces become unavailable, fresh tracking receives fresh identities and cleanup leaves no stale tracking/presentation resources. Retain existing plane-space anchor placement and mesh interoperability assertions.
- [ ] Extend and execute `npx tsx tests/reference-space-browser.ts chromium planes` and its `firefox planes` counterpart through the existing genuine extension/panel routes. Run `npm run build:firefox`, including typecheck/build, and focused `npm run test:meshes:chromium`/`firefox` checks for shared-registry and populated-child compatibility. If geometry/backend code changes, include its affected environment checks. The Coordinator owns execution and normal PR review; add no independent AI re-review or generic application/suite rerun.
- [ ] Correct the inventory/documentation claim that plane bindings are complete. Record actual commands, browser/tool versions, tested source/bundle hashes, instrumentation, failures, skips and unperformed checks separately from historical results. The lockfile currently records Playwright 1.64.0, Three.js 0.186.1 and TypeScript 5.9.3.
- [ ] For any mistaken AI requirement, retain the original assumption, correction, pinned primary evidence and rationale in the Issue/PR. Apply evidence-backed corrections without human approval or independent AI re-review, preserving the fixed goal and meaningful acceptance rather than accommodating unfinished code or failures.

## Optional validation

Additional same-origin popup coverage or a targeted pinned plane-consumer scenario if the allocation change affects observable rendering. No generic application rerun is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WebXR API compatibility goal for
Quest 3 VR/MR and Android AR. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
